comments: Reads page HTML without running scripts. Every check and its known false positives and negatives are listed at https://valleyfill.com/snapshot/about.html. Follows robots.txt (user agent token ValleyFillSnapshot).
features: Free online check for public bodies. Enter a site to see its likely ADA Title II web deadline and basic signals from up to 10 pages and 5 PDFs: page language, title, images with no alt, unlabeled form fields, empty links and buttons, zoom disabled, untitled frames, autoplay, and PDF tags. Not an audit; many WCAG checks need a person.
title: ValleyFill Title II Snapshot
